content: The Anthropic provider currently cannot initiate delegation: its request does not declare `delegate_task`, and its stream parser handles text deltas but not tool-use blocks. Its continuation request also lacks the assistant tool-use and user tool-result history required by the Anthropic API. I’ll address those gaps alongside the handler implementation and verify the full flow.
